# Jig

Jig is a local, secure host for admitted FLOW packages.

- Landing page: https://jig.md/
- Direct-alpha guide: https://jig.md/guide/
- Project Authoring SDK: https://jig.md/spec/project-sdk
- Project and execution policy: https://jig.md/spec/project-policy
- Security boundary: https://github.com/jigmd/jig/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Source and installation: https://github.com/jigmd/jig
- FLOW specifications: https://flow.jig.md/
